scientific_integrity: Proof is self-contained; finite checker supports but does not replace all-length derivations. The source warns that its proposed chaotic adjacency is not a model for actual periodic rotor orbits.
scientific_limitations: Only the abstract no-repeat ternary symbolic SFT; not an assertion of realized three-rotor physical periodic trajectories. Prior equivalent classical necklace formulas cannot be excluded; no independent audit.
title: Primitive chirality and zero-winding sectors of the ternary rotor-symbol surrogate
